title: Assessment Details
prompt: A two-column table of the key details of the assessment: company, industry, date, advisors and company participants.

title: 1. Executive Summary
prompt: One paragraph: the company, its AI maturity, the top-priority use case and its expected benefit, and the main recommendation.
summary_of: 6. Validity of Concept and Authenticity of Problem Addressed
7. Integration and Importance of AI in the Idea

title: 2. Company Overview
prompt: Founding and ownership, size, sites, services, customer segments, current pressures and strategic goals.

title: 3. AI Maturity Level
prompt: Current systems, current use of AI and automation, how the work is organised, and the company's motivation. End with the maturity rating and its justification.
required_items: AI maturity rating: Low, Moderate or High

title: 4. Current Solution Development Stage
prompt: The stage of the AI work (for example ideation or pilot), the use cases identified so far, how the relevant processes run today, and the objectives.
required_items: development stage of the AI solutions

title: 5. Identified Use Cases and Prioritisation
prompt: A table of the identified use cases with current process and pain point, expected benefit, feasibility and priority, followed by short prose on which use case comes first, which next and which is deferred, and why.

title: 6. Validity of Concept and Authenticity of Problem Addressed
prompt: Evidence that the problems are real and measurable, and which concept is closest to implementation.

title: 7. Integration and Importance of AI in the Idea
prompt: The role of AI in each use case, the technique, and how central it is compared with conventional methods or human work.

title: 8. Identified Target Market and Customer Segments
prompt: The customer base and segments, attitudes, and which segments the AI initiatives would affect first.

title: 9. Data Requirement Assessment
prompt: The data each use case needs, where it is held, its history and quality, and the gaps.

title: 10. Data Collection Strategy
prompt: Data strategy, owners, how data is recorded and governed, and what is needed to close the gaps.

title: 11. Technical Expertise and Capability
prompt: In-house skills, external partners, system landscape and readiness for change, and implications for delivery.

title: 12. Risks, Compliance and Responsible AI
prompt: Technical, organisational and compliance risks, how public AI tools are used and governed, data protection and ownership, public-sector or regulatory mitigations.

title: 13. Budget and Funding
prompt: Past investments in AI, the willingness to invest, the amount management is willing to commit, and funding options considered.
required_items: the amount management is willing to invest in AI

title: 14. Expectations from FAIR Services
prompt: What the company expects from the advisory service: scoping, advice, policy, training and funding support.

title: 15. Recommendations
prompt: A bulleted list of concrete recommendations made during the assessment: scope, data preparation, human-in-the-loop controls, what to postpone and why.

title: 16. Next Steps and Action Items
prompt: A table of agreed action items with the person responsible and the deadline, and the next meeting.

title: Appendix: Sources
prompt: A bulleted list of the source materials used, each with its type and date.
